**Before opening this**

Check [`docs/features.md`](../../docs/features.md). Many capabilities are already specified as
deferred (F-18 to F-28), each with an unlock condition. If yours is there, say what evidence you
have that the condition is met -- that is more useful than a new request.

One capability, dead-code detection, is explicitly **rejected** rather than deferred; the
reasoning is in features.md section 5.
